## ICO Award for Excellence in Coffee-Related Research

**International Coffee Organization (ICO)** · June 2019

The ICO Award for Excellence in Coffee-Related Research recognizes outstanding contributions to the understanding of emerging issues in the global coffee sector. The award was granted for the paper *Access to High Quality Coffee Markets: Possible for All?*, which examines barriers to specialty market participation among smallholder coffee producers.

[Award call](http://www.ico.org/documents/cy2018-19/ed-2295e-call-for-award-competition.pdf){target="_blank"}

## COLCIENCIAS Doctoral Scholarship

**Minciencias (formerly COLCIENCIAS)** · 2017–2020

National doctoral scholarship awarded by Colombia's Department of Science and Technology to support PhD studies in Economics at Universidad de los Andes.
